  ## AUTOGENERATED TITLE START

.. _alg-enmapbox-matchrastertimeserieswithpointsofinterest:

***********************************************
Match raster timeseries with points of interest
***********************************************

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED TITLE END

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED DESCRIPTION START

Creates a new `point layer <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-point-layer>`_ containing the `attributes <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-attribute>`_ of the input `layer <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-layer>`_ together with raster matching information for the pixel covered by each point and temporally closest to the `target <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-target>`_ date. The `output <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-output>`_ includes the raster source \(match-source\), pixel coordinates \(match-px, match-py\), the extracted `pixel profile <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-pixel-profile>`_ \(match-profile\), and the temporal offset to the target date \(match-dt\).

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED DESCRIPTION END

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED PARAMETERS START

**Parameters**

:guilabel:`Time series` [file]
    A time series to `sample <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-sample>`_ data from.

:guilabel:`Points of interest` [vector]
    A vector `point layer <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-point-layer>`_ defining the locations to match and `sample <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-sample>`_.

:guilabel:`Date field` [field]
    `Field <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-field>`_ with `target <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-target>`_ date.

:guilabel:`Maximum temporal offset` [string]
    Maximum allowed time difference between the `target <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-target>`_ date and a candidate observation. The value must be specified as a combination of time units using the format:\<years\>`y <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-y>`_ \<months\>M \<days\>d \<hours\>h \<minutes\>m \<seconds\>s
    Examples:  30d → 30 days
      2M 15d → 2 months and 15 days
      1y 6M → 1 year and 6 months
      2y 3M 5d 4h 30m 15s → 2 years, 3 months, 5 days, 4 hours, 30 minutes, and 15 seconds
    Units may be omitted if not needed. Use uppercase M for months and lowercase m for minutes.

:guilabel:`Extract pixel profiles` [boolean]
    Whether to extract `pixel profiles <https://enmap-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/general/glossary.html#term-pixel-profile>`_.
    Default: *False*

**Outputs**

:guilabel:`Output point layer` [vectorDestination]
    Vector file destination.

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED PARAMETERS END

..
  ## AUTOGENERATED COMMAND USAGE START

**Command-line usage**

``>qgis_process help enmapbox:matchrastertimeserieswithpointsofinterest``::

    ----------------
    Arguments
    ----------------

    timeSeries: Time series
        Argument type:    file
        Acceptable values:
            - Path to a file
    poi: Points of interest
        Argument type:    vector
        Acceptable values:
            - Path to a vector layer
    dateField: Date field
        Argument type:    field
        Acceptable values:
            - The name of an existing field
            - ; delimited list of existing field names
    maximumTemporalOffset: Maximum temporal offset (optional)
        Argument type:    string
        Acceptable values:
            - String value
            - field:FIELD_NAME to use a data defined value taken from the FIELD_NAME field
            - expression:SOME EXPRESSION to use a data defined value calculated using a custom QGIS expression
    extractProfile: Extract pixel profiles (optional)
        Default value:    false
        Argument type:    boolean
        Acceptable values:
            - 1 for true/yes
            - 0 for false/no
            - field:FIELD_NAME to use a data defined value taken from the FIELD_NAME field
            - expression:SOME EXPRESSION to use a data defined value calculated using a custom QGIS expression
    outputPoints: Output point layer
        Argument type:    vectorDestination
        Acceptable values:
            - Path for new vector layer

    ----------------
    Outputs
    ----------------

    outputPoints: <outputVector>
        Output point layer
